problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 are unsupported (memorial ceremony and WPBN reporting on remembrance activities are not in the source text). Fact 3 ('military installation in northern Michigan') is unsupported by the source text, which only states 'Camp Grayling hosts multiagency wildfire training in Crawford County'. Fact 2 ('The training involved multiple agencies working together on wildfire response') is supported but needs attribution. The dek references November 2026, but the source timestamp is 2026-11-23, which is acceptable but should be verified against the source date format. The body contains unsupported claims about memorial ceremonies and WPBN reporting on remembrance. The context section invents background not in the source. The article repeats the opening sentence structure in multiple paragraphs. No sources provide dates, agency names, or memorial details.
